_comment: 模拟版本（草稿）— 全部文本待公益律师校对后才可对外宣称准确。依据：反家庭暴力法(2016)、最高法2022保护令规定、民法典1091条、公安机关办理刑事案件程序规定。

title.en: What to Do When Someone Is Being Abused

tagline.en: From that night to a protection order — practice each decision safely, before it's real.
tagline.zh: 从案发当晚到人身安全保护令——在安全的环境里，把每一步先走一遍。

intro.en: You will walk through a realistic sequence of decisions. Every option exists in real life, and every consequence follows real legal rules. Nothing you choose here is recorded.
intro.zh: 你将经历一连串真实存在的决策点。每个选项都是现实中真实的选择，每个后果都遵循真实的法律规则。你在这里的任何选择都不会被记录。

narration.en: Late at night, during an argument, he hits you for the first time. Your arm and shoulder are bruised — not severe, but you are shaken. He storms out. You are alone in the apartment.
narration.zh: 深夜，一次争吵中，他第一次动了手。伤在手臂和肩膀，不算重，但你吓坏了。他摔门出去，家里只剩你一个人。

coach.en: What you do in the next hour affects whether you can ever prove what happened.
coach.zh: 接下来一小时你做的每件事，都会影响以后能不能证明发生过什么。

text.en: Call 110 and report it
text.zh: 拨打 110 报警

feedback.en: The call is logged. From this moment an official record of tonight exists.
feedback.zh: 你拨通了110。从这一刻起，今晚这件事有了官方记录——接警记录本身就是证据。

text.en: Photograph your injuries and the scene first
text.zh: 先拍下伤处和现场的照片

feedback.en: You photograph the bruises and the broken things on the floor. The photos carry tonight's timestamp.
feedback.zh: 你拍下了手臂和肩膀的淤青，还有摔碎的东西。照片带着今晚的时间戳。

text.en: You're too frightened — you lock the bedroom door and wait for morning
text.zh: 太害怕了，锁上房门，等天亮

feedback.en: The night passes and leaves no record. That is not your fault — and there are still chances ahead.
feedback.zh: 这一晚过去了，没有留下任何记录。这不是你的错——接下来还有机会。

narration.en: The photos are saved somewhere safe. What now?
narration.zh: 照片已经存到了安全的地方。现在呢？

text.en: Call 110 as well
text.zh: 还是报警

feedback.en: Photos plus a police dispatch record — two kinds of evidence that corroborate each other.
feedback.zh: 伤照 + 出警记录，两类证据可以互相印证。

text.en: Let it go this time — keep it inside the family
text.zh: 这次先算了，家丑不外扬

feedback.en: You decide not to call. The photos exist, but there is no official record of tonight.
feedback.zh: 你决定先不报警。照片还在，但今晚没有任何官方记录。

narration.en: Two officers arrive at the door.

line.en: "A family matter, this late at night... How about we mediate a little, and everyone calms down?"
line.zh: “家务事嘛，大半夜的……要不我们给你们调解一下，都消消气？”

coach.en: The dispatch record and the written statement (询问笔录) are the core official evidence for a future protection order or divorce case.
coach.zh: 出警记录和询问笔录，是日后申请保护令、离婚诉讼最核心的官方证据。

text.en: Ask them to take a written statement, and request the report receipt
text.zh: 要求做询问笔录，并索要报警回执

feedback.en: The officers take your statement and you receive the receipt. The paperwork now says the date, the place, and the word "beaten".
feedback.zh: 民警制作了笔录，你拿到了报警回执。这些材料上写着日期、地点，和“殴打”两个字。

text.en: Say it clearly: "He hit me. I ask you to handle this according to law."
text.zh: 说清楚：“他打了我，我要求依法处理。”

feedback.en: Your firmness changes the tone: the officers begin a formal written record.
feedback.zh: 你的坚决让处理正式化了：民警开始制作笔录。

text.en: Accept a quick verbal mediation and let them leave
text.zh: 接受口头调解，让他们走

feedback.en: The officers mediate and leave. No statement, no receipt — this visit survives only in your memory.
feedback.zh: 民警调解几句就走了。没有笔录、没有回执——这次出警只留在你自己的记忆里。

line.en: "The injuries don't look serious. Do you want a forensic injury assessment? Your call."
line.zh: “伤看着不重。要不要做伤情鉴定？你自己定。”

coach.en: Injury assessment is time-sensitive — once bruises fade, they can no longer be certified. 轻微伤 can bring administrative punishment; 轻伤 or worse makes it a criminal case.
coach.zh: 伤情鉴定有时限——淤青消退后就鉴定不出来了。轻微伤可治安处罚；轻伤及以上就是刑事案件。

text.en: Request the assessment referral and go first thing tomorrow
text.zh: 要求开具鉴定委托，明天一早就去

feedback.en: Result: minor injury (轻微伤). This document turns the bruises into a legally recognized fact.
feedback.zh: 鉴定结论：轻微伤。这份文书把身上的伤变成了法律上认可的事实。

text.en: "It's not that bad, no need."
text.zh: “伤不重，不用了吧。”

feedback.en: No assessment. Days later the bruises fade — in the eyes of the law, they never existed.
feedback.zh: 没有做鉴定。几天后淤青退了——在法律上，这两处伤从未存在过。

narration.en: At the police station, the handling officer concludes the matter is "relatively minor".
narration.zh: 在派出所，办案民警认为情节较轻。

line.en: "He admitted it and apologized. We'll criticize and educate him this time. You two go home and work it out."
line.zh: “他也认错了，这次就先批评教育。你们回去好好过。”

coach.en: When the case is minor and no administrative punishment is given, the police SHALL issue a written warning letter (告诫书, Anti-DV Law art. 16) — you can ask for it.
coach.zh: 情节较轻不予治安处罚的，公安应当出具《家庭暴力告诫书》（反家暴法第16条）——可以主动要求。

text.en: Ask them to issue a Domestic Violence Warning Letter (告诫书)
text.zh: 主动要求出具《家庭暴力告诫书》

feedback.en: The letter is issued: served on him, archived at the station. When a court later needs to find that violence occurred, this is official documentary proof.
feedback.zh: 告诫书出具了：送达给他，也在派出所存档。日后法院认定家暴时，这就是官方书证。

text.en: You've never heard of such a letter — you leave
text.zh: 没听说过告诫书，就这样吧

feedback.en: You leave the station with no written result in hand.
feedback.zh: 你离开了派出所，手上没有任何书面处理结果。

narration.en: The next day he apologizes, red-eyed, and hand-writes a pledge: "I swear I will never raise my hand again."
narration.zh: 第二天，他红着眼睛道歉，手写了一份保证书：“我保证再也不动手。”

coach.en: Written pledges and apologies are explicitly listed by the Supreme Court (2022) as admissible evidence of domestic violence.
coach.zh: 悔过书、保证书是最高法2022年规定明确列举的家暴证据之一。

text.en: Keep the pledge somewhere only you know
text.zh: 收下保证书，存到只有自己知道的地方

feedback.en: The pledge admits, in his own handwriting, that he hit you.
feedback.zh: 这份保证书用他自己的笔迹承认了“动手”这个事实。

text.en: Tear it up — you can't stand looking at it
text.zh: 撕掉，看到就难受

feedback.en: The pledge is gone. It could have proven, in his own words, what he did.
feedback.zh: 保证书没有了。它本可以用他自己的话证明他做过什么。

narration.en: Three weeks later, during another argument, he shoves you to the floor and says: "Call the police, see if I care." You move to a friend's place. He waits downstairs every day.
narration.zh: 三周后，又一次争吵中，他把你推倒在地，还说“你敢报警试试”。你搬去朋友家住，他每天在楼下等你。

coach.en: A Personal Safety Protection Order does not require filing for divorce, and does not require his presence or consent.
coach.zh: 人身安全保护令：不需要先起诉离婚，也不需要他到场或同意。

text.en: Apply to the court for a Personal Safety Protection Order
text.zh: 向法院申请人身安全保护令

text.en: You believe you must sue for divorce first — start saving for a lawyer
text.zh: 以为要先起诉离婚才能申请，先攒钱找律师

feedback.en: A week passes while he keeps appearing downstairs.
feedback.zh: 一周过去了，他还是每天出现在楼下。

text.en: Call 110 again — and this time firmly request written handling
text.zh: 再次拨打110，这次坚决要求书面处理

feedback.en: The officers take a formal statement this time.
feedback.zh: 民警这次做了正式笔录。

narration.en: A week later you finally sit down with a legal-aid lawyer (12348).
narration.zh: 一周后，你终于见到了法律援助律师（12348）。

line.en: "Who told you divorce comes first? The protection order is independent — no divorce needed, he doesn't have to be present. You can apply to the court today."
line.zh: “谁说要先离婚？保护令是独立的——不需要离婚，不需要他到场，今天就可以向法院申请。”

text.en: Apply right away
text.zh: 那现在就去申请

feedback.en: Fortunately this misconception only cost a week.
feedback.zh: 好在这个误区只耽误了一周。

text.en: Hold off — you're afraid it will provoke him
text.zh: 再想想，怕激怒他

feedback.en: Many people stop here. The danger downstairs does not stop with them.
feedback.zh: 很多人停在了这一步。但楼下的危险不会跟着停下。

narration.en: As they leave, a young officer lowers his voice: "For a situation like yours, you can apply to the court for a Personal Safety Protection Order. It's fast."
narration.zh: 临走时，一位年轻民警压低声音说：“你这种情况，可以去法院申请人身安全保护令，很快的。”

text.en: Go to the court the next morning
text.zh: 第二天一早就去法院

text.en: Not yet — you're afraid of escalating things
text.zh: 先不了，怕把事情闹大

feedback.en: You put the idea away. He is still downstairs tomorrow.
feedback.zh: 你把这个念头收了起来。明天，他还会在楼下。

narration.en: At the court filing window, the clerk asks: "What materials do you have showing domestic violence or a real risk of it?"
narration.zh: 在法院立案窗口，工作人员问：“有什么材料能证明存在家暴，或者存在现实危险？”

coach.en: The standard of proof is "a fairly high likelihood" (较大可能性) — lower than an ordinary civil case. Dispatch records, warning letters, injury photos, written pledges, and witness accounts all count.
coach.zh: 保护令的证明标准是“较大可能性”——低于一般民事案件。出警记录、告诫书、伤照、保证书、证人证言都算数。

text.en: Submit everything you have
text.zh: 把手上所有材料都交上去

text.en: You feel your materials are too thin — you turn back
text.zh: 觉得材料太少拿不出手，回去了

feedback.en: Many people give up at this exact step — even though the threshold is much lower than they imagine.
feedback.zh: 很多人正是在这一步放弃的——其实“较大可能性”的门槛比想象中低得多。

narration.en: The court issued the order within 72 hours. With the warning letter and police dispatch record on file, the judge had little hesitation: he is now legally barred from assaulting, threatening, stalking, or contacting you. Violating the order means detention; repeated violations can be prosecuted criminally.
narration.zh: 法院在72小时内签发裁定。案卷里有告诫书和出警记录，法官几乎没有犹豫：裁定禁止他殴打、威胁、跟踪、接触你。违反保护令可被拘留，情节严重的可追刑责。

coach.en: The protection order is a real legal barrier — but not the end of the road. Divorce proceedings (§1091 damages) and criminal prosecution can run in parallel or follow later.
coach.zh: 保护令是真实的法律屏障——但不是终点。离婚诉讼（§1091损害赔偿）和刑事追诉可以同步走，也可以之后再决定。

text.en: File for divorce and claim damages
text.zh: 向法院起诉离婚，同时主张损害赔偿

text.en: Ask police to open a criminal case for intentional injury
text.zh: 要求公安以故意伤害罪对他立案

text.en: The order is enough for now — I'll decide later
text.zh: 先有保护令就够了，其他之后再决定

narration.en: The court ruled within 72 hours. The police record and your written statement cleared the 'significant likelihood' threshold. He is legally barred from approaching or contacting you.
narration.zh: 法院在72小时内作出裁定。出警记录和询问笔录越过了「较大可能性」的门槛。裁定禁止他接近、接触你。

coach.en: The protection order is in effect. Divorce proceedings and a criminal case can run alongside it — they use the same evidence you already have.
coach.zh: 保护令已生效。离婚诉讼和刑事立案都可以并行推进——用的正是你已经有的证据。

text.en: File for divorce and claim damages
text.zh: 向法院起诉离婚，同时主张损害赔偿

text.en: Ask police to open a criminal case for intentional injury
text.zh: 要求公安以故意伤害罪对他立案

text.en: The order is enough for now
text.zh: 先有保护令就够了

narration.en: The order was granted — although the process was much harder than it needed to be. No official records existed; the court eventually pulled in the women's federation's support records to cross-reference. The order stands.
narration.zh: 保护令还是签发了——虽然过程比本可以的样子艰难得多。没有官方记录，法院最终向妇联调取了你的求助记录来印证。裁定有效。

coach.en: The order is in force. Divorce is still an option. From today, every police call and every piece of written documentation rebuilds your evidence chain.
coach.zh: 保护令已生效。离婚诉讼随时可以走。从今天起，每一次报警、每一份书面材料都在重新积累证据链。

text.en: File for divorce
text.zh: 向法院起诉离婚

text.en: Stabilise first, decide later
text.zh: 先稳定下来，之后再决定

narration.en: You submit your divorce petition to the local court, attaching all the evidence you have collected.
narration.zh: 你向居住地基层法院提交了离婚诉状，附上了你收集到的全部证据材料。

coach.en: Civil Code §1079: domestic violence is grounds for divorce when mediation fails — courts must grant it. §1091: as the innocent party you can claim damages. Note: if he contests and a first ruling denies the divorce, you can re-file 6 months later — courts almost always grant it the second time.
coach.zh: 民法典第1079条：有家庭暴力、调解无效的，法院应当准予离婚。第1091条：家暴是无过错方主张损害赔偿的法定事由。注意：如果对方不同意、第一次被判不准离婚，6个月后可以再次起诉，届时基本会准。

narration.en: You formally request that police open a criminal case against him for intentional injury.
narration.zh: 你正式要求公安以故意伤害罪对他立案侦查。

coach.en: Criminal Law §234: domestic violence causing minor injury or above constitutes intentional injury — a public-prosecution offence. Once opened, the case can continue even if you later withdraw your complaint. The injury assessment result is the key threshold.
coach.zh: 刑法第234条：家庭暴力致人轻伤以上，构成故意伤害罪——公诉案件。案件一旦立案，即使你事后撤诉，检察院仍有权提起公诉。伤情鉴定结论是能否走刑事路径的关键门槛。

title.en: Application denied — nothing on record
title.zh: 未获签发——什么记录都没有

summary.en: No police record, no photos, no written pledge — the court finds the materials insufficient even for the lowered standard. Nothing here is your fault. And it is not the end: from today, every incident reported, every injury assessed, every paper kept, rebuilds the case.
summary.zh: 没有出警记录、没有照片、没有保证书——即便是降低了的证明标准，现有材料也不足以支撑。这不是你的错。而且这不是终点：从今天起，每次报警、每次验伤、每份留下的书面材料，都在重新把证据链建起来。

title.en: The application never happened

summary.en: Without the order, there is no legal barrier between you and the person downstairs. The simulation ends here — but in real life, it is never too late to start keeping records and ask again. The 12338 hotline and legal aid (12348) exist exactly for this moment.
summary.zh: 没有保护令，你和楼下那个人之间就没有任何法律屏障。模拟到这里结束——但在现实中，任何时候重新开始留证据、重新申请都不算晚。12338 和 12348 热线，正是为这一刻存在的。

title.en: The order stands — you have time

summary.en: The protection order is the most immediate legal barrier right now. Violating it means detention; repeated violations can be criminally prosecuted. The door to divorce proceedings and a criminal case stays open — there is no urgent deadline. 12338 / 12348 can help you think through the next step whenever you're ready.
summary.zh: 保护令是现阶段最直接的法律屏障。违反保护令可被拘留，情节严重的可追刑责。离婚诉讼和刑事报案的路随时还开着——没有紧迫的时效压力。12338 / 12348 随时可以帮你评估下一步。

title.en: Divorce granted — with damages
title.zh: 准予离婚——并获得损害赔偿

summary.en: With the warning letter and police records in the file, the court found domestic violence proven, granted the divorce under Civil Code §1079, and declared you the innocent party. In the property division the court took your circumstances into account; your §1091 damages claim was also recognised. This is the most complete civil remedy in a domestic-violence case.
summary.zh: 有告诫书和出警记录在案，法院依据民法典第1079条第3款认定家庭暴力，准予离婚，认定他为有过错方。财产分割时法院照顾了你；你依据第1091条主张的损害赔偿也获得支持。这是家暴案件民事救济最完整的结果。

title.en: First petition denied — but the second almost always succeeds
title.zh: 第一次被驳回——但第二次通常会准

summary.en: He contested the divorce. The court ruled that 'the marriage bond has not completely broken down' and denied the petition — this is extremely common in domestic-violence divorces on the first attempt, and is not your fault. The law gives you a clear next step: 6 months after this judgment takes effect you can re-file; courts almost always grant the divorce the second time, and you can simultaneously claim damages under Civil Code §1091.
summary.zh: 他不同意离婚，法院以「感情尚未完全破裂」为由判决不准离婚——这在家暴离婚案第一次起诉时极为常见，不是你的错。法律给了你明确的下一步：本次判决生效6个月后，你可以再次提起离婚诉讼；届时法院通常准予离婚，并可同时主张民法典第1091条的损害赔偿。

title.en: Criminal case opened — he faces state prosecution
title.zh: 刑事立案——他面对的是国家追诉

summary.en: The injury assessment confirmed minor injury or above. Police opened a criminal case under Criminal Law §234 (intentional injury) and transferred it to the procuratorate for prosecution. This is a public-prosecution offence: the state pursues him, not you alone. Even if you later withdraw your complaint, the procuratorate can still proceed. The protection order and divorce petition remain valid in parallel.
summary.zh: 伤情鉴定结论达到轻伤以上，公安以故意伤害罪（刑法第234条）立案，移送检察院提起公诉。这是公诉案件：是国家在追诉他，不是你一个人在扛。即使你事后撤诉，检察院仍有权继续起诉。保护令和离婚诉讼并行有效。

title.en: No criminal case — but the other paths stay open
title.zh: 刑事路径暂时关上——其他路还在

summary.en: Without an injury assessment, police cannot confirm the injury grade and cannot treat this as a criminal matter — only an administrative penalty. The protection order remains in force. From today: report every incident, seek injury assessment immediately each time. The criminal path can reopen the moment the evidence is there.
summary.zh: 没有伤情鉴定，公安无法确认伤势等级，无法以刑事案件处理，维持治安处罚。保护令仍然有效。从今天起：每次都报警，每次都立即去做伤情鉴定——证据到位，刑事路径随时可以重启。

title.en: You called the police the night it happened

detail.en: The dispatch record is the earliest official timestamp of the violence — the single most useful document in every later proceeding.
detail.zh: 接警/出警记录是这起暴力最早的官方时间戳，也是之后每一个程序里最有用的一份材料。

basis.en: Police dispatch records are listed by the Supreme Court (2022) as evidence for protection order cases.
basis.zh: 最高法2022年保护令规定明确将出警记录列为可用证据。

title.en: The police were never called

detail.en: Without any report, no official record of the violence exists anywhere. The correct move: call 110 every single time — even if nothing else follows, the record accumulates.
detail.zh: 从未报警，暴力就在任何官方系统里都不存在。正确做法：每一次都拨打110——哪怕后续什么都不做，记录本身在累积。

basis.en: Anti-DV Law art. 15: police must respond, stop the violence, and make records.
basis.zh: 反家暴法第15条：公安接警后应当出警、制止家暴并做好记录。

title.en: You photographed the injuries immediately

detail.en: Timestamped injury photos corroborate every other piece of evidence.
detail.zh: 带时间戳的伤照可以和其他所有证据互相印证。

basis.en: Injury photos are among the evidence types listed in the 2022 Supreme Court provisions.
basis.zh: 伤照属于最高法2022年规定列举的证据类型。

title.en: You asked for the written statement and receipt
title.zh: 要求了笔录，拿到了回执

detail.en: Most people don't know they can ask. The written statement is what turns a police visit into usable evidence.
detail.zh: 多数人不知道可以主动要求。正是笔录和回执，把一次出警变成了能用的证据。

basis.en: Under police case-handling rules, a receipt is issued on registering a report; statements become part of the case file.
basis.zh: 按公安办案程序规定，受案登记应出具回执；询问笔录进入案卷。

title.en: The visit ended in verbal mediation only

detail.en: No statement, no receipt — the system step that failed here was leaving without anything in writing. The correct move: always request the written statement and the report receipt before officers leave.
detail.zh: 没有笔录、没有回执——这一环节缺的是任何书面材料。正确做法：在民警离开前，要求制作询问笔录并索要报警回执。

basis.en: Dispatch records and statements are core protection-order evidence (Supreme Court 2022).
basis.zh: 出警记录与笔录是保护令的核心证据（最高法2022年规定）。

title.en: You had the injuries assessed in time

detail.en: The assessment fixes the injury as a legal fact before it fades, and determines whether the case is administrative or criminal.
detail.zh: 鉴定在伤退之前把它固定为法律事实，并决定案件走治安处罚还是刑事立案。

basis.en: 轻微伤 → administrative punishment; 轻伤 or above → criminal case (intentional injury).
basis.zh: 轻微伤对应治安处罚；轻伤及以上对应刑事立案（故意伤害罪）。

title.en: The injury assessment window was missed

detail.en: Once bruises fade they can no longer be certified. The correct move: request the assessment referral at the scene and go as early as possible.
detail.zh: 淤青消退后就无法鉴定了。正确做法：当场要求开具鉴定委托，尽早前往鉴定。

basis.en: Injury assessment is inherently time-sensitive; delay is one of the most common irreversible mistakes.
basis.zh: 伤情鉴定天然有时限性，拖延是最常见且不可逆的失误之一。

title.en: You asked for the warning letter (告诫书)
title.zh: 主动要到了《家庭暴力告诫书》

detail.en: The letter is official written proof that violence occurred — courts use it directly to find domestic violence.
detail.zh: 告诫书是官方书面认定发生过家暴的证据——法院可以直接据此认定家暴事实。

basis.en: Anti-DV Law art. 16: where the case is minor and no punishment is imposed, police shall issue a warning letter.
basis.zh: 反家暴法第16条：情节较轻依法不予治安处罚的，公安机关应当出具告诫书。

title.en: No warning letter was requested

detail.en: The step that failed: leaving the station without any written outcome. The correct move: when told the matter is "minor", ask for the Domestic Violence Warning Letter by name — the police are required to issue it.
detail.zh: 缺失的环节：离开派出所时没有任何书面处理结果。正确做法：听到“情节较轻”时，点名要求出具《家庭暴力告诫书》——这是公安应当出具的。

title.en: You kept his written pledge

detail.en: An admission in his own handwriting — explicitly listed as admissible evidence.
detail.zh: 他亲笔写下的承认——被明确列举为可用证据。

basis.en: Written pledges/apologies are listed in the Supreme Court 2022 provisions.
basis.zh: 悔过书、保证书见于最高法2022年规定的证据列举。

title.en: The written pledge was destroyed

detail.en: Understandable — and the missing method here is: papers where he admits what he did are evidence, however painful to keep. Store them somewhere he cannot reach (photograph them too).
detail.zh: 完全可以理解——但这一环节缺失的方法是：凡是他承认动手的书面材料都是证据，再难受也值得保存。可以存放在他接触不到的地方（同时拍照备份）。

basis.en: Written pledges are listed evidence (Supreme Court 2022).
basis.zh: 保证书属于明确列举的证据（最高法2022年规定）。

title.en: A misconception delayed the protection order

detail.en: The order does not require divorce proceedings, his consent, or his presence. The correct move: apply directly to the basic court where you or he lives — courts rule within 72 hours (24 in urgent cases).
detail.zh: 保护令不需要先离婚、不需要他同意、不需要他到场。正确做法：直接向你或他居住地的基层法院申请——法院72小时内裁定，紧急情况24小时。

basis.en: Anti-DV Law arts. 23–32; Supreme Court 2022 provisions.
basis.zh: 反家暴法第23-32条；最高法2022年规定。

title.en: You applied for the protection order
title.zh: 申请了人身安全保护令

detail.en: The single most direct legal barrier available — independent of divorce, fast, and enforceable.
detail.zh: 这是现有制度里最直接的法律屏障——独立于离婚程序，裁定快，且可强制执行。

basis.en: Anti-DV Law arts. 23–32: ruling within 72 hours (24 if urgent); violation can mean fines, detention, or criminal liability.
basis.zh: 反家暴法第23-32条：72小时内裁定（紧急24小时）；违反可罚款、拘留，构成犯罪的追究刑责。

title.en: The application was abandoned

detail.en: Fear of provoking him is real and rational — the missing piece here is knowing the order is designed exactly for that fear: it legally forbids contact and retaliation, and violating it brings detention or criminal liability. Help lines (12338 / 12348) and the Women's Federation can accompany the application; in some situations they can even apply on your behalf.
detail.zh: 怕激怒他，是真实而合理的恐惧——这一环节缺失的信息是：保护令正是为这种恐惧设计的，它在法律上禁止接触和报复，违反就面临拘留甚至刑责。12338 / 12348 和妇联可以陪同申请；特定情形下她们甚至可以代为申请。

basis.en: Anti-DV Law art. 23: relatives, the Women's Federation, and others may apply on behalf of victims unable to do so.
basis.zh: 反家暴法第23条：无法自行申请时，近亲属、妇联等可以代为申请。

realFlow.en: Call 110 immediately — even if you're unsure. The police dispatch record is the most important official timestamp of the violence.
realFlow.zh: 第一时间拨打110报案——哪怕还没想好要怎么处理。接警记录是暴力最重要的官方时间戳。

realFlow.en: Photograph injuries right away (with timestamp on), both close-up and full body.
realFlow.zh: 立即拍摄伤照，开启时间戳，近景和全身各一组。

realFlow.en: Before police leave: request a written statement (询问笔录) and ask for the police receipt (报警回执) — you are entitled to both.
realFlow.zh: 民警离开前：要求制作询问笔录，并索要报警回执——这两样都是你有权要求的。

realFlow.en: Go to a hospital or judicial appraisal center for an injury assessment (伤情鉴定) as soon as possible — bruises fade quickly.
realFlow.zh: 尽快前往医院或司法鉴定机构做伤情鉴定——淤青消退后就无法鉴定了。

realFlow.en: Ask the police station to issue a Domestic Violence Warning Letter (家庭暴力告诫书). Say those exact words — police are required to issue one.
realFlow.zh: 要求派出所出具《家庭暴力告诫书》，直接说这个名字——公安有义务出具。

realFlow.en: Apply to the local court for a Personal Safety Protection Order (人身安全保护令). Court must rule within 72 hours (24 hours in emergencies). No divorce required; his consent is not needed.
realFlow.zh: 向居住地基层法院申请人身安全保护令。法院72小时内裁定，紧急时24小时。不需要先离婚，不需要他同意。

realFlow.en: Keep all documents (警方回执, 告诫书, 保护令, 他写的任何承认) in a place he cannot access — and photograph each one as a backup.
realFlow.zh: 将所有书面材料（回执、告诫书、保护令、他写的任何承认）存放在他接触不到的地方，并逐一拍照备份。

term.en: Personal Safety Protection Order (人身安全保护令)

note.en: A court order that legally prohibits the abuser from contacting, approaching, or harming you. Applied to the local court; ruled within 72 hours (24 in emergencies). You don't need to divorce first, and his consent is not required. Violating it can lead to detention or criminal charges.
note.zh: 法院出具的法律文书，正式禁止施暴者接触、靠近或伤害你。向居住地基层法院申请，72小时内裁定，紧急情况24小时。不需要先离婚，不需要他同意。违反保护令可被拘留，情节严重的追刑责。

term.en: Domestic Violence Warning Letter (家庭暴力告诫书)

note.en: An official document issued by the police station that formally acknowledges domestic violence occurred. Courts can use it directly as evidence of abuse — you don't need to prove the violence all over again.
note.zh: 派出所出具的官方文书，正式认定发生了家暴。法院可以直接凭告诫书认定家暴事实，无需你再重新举证。

note.en: A formal medical-legal evaluation of your injuries, done by a certified judicial appraisal center. The grade determines whether the case goes through administrative penalty (治安处罚) or criminal prosecution (刑事立案). Do it as soon as possible — bruising disappears.
note.zh: 由司法鉴定机构对伤势进行专业评级。评级结果决定案件走《治安处罚》还是《刑事立案》路径。越早做越好——淤青会消退。

note.en: A slip given by police confirming they received your report. Keep it — every later step (injury assessment referral, protection order, divorce proceeding) may ask for it.
note.zh: 民警确认受理报案后给你的凭条。一定要保留——后续伤情鉴定委托、保护令申请、离婚诉讼都可能用到它。
